Bands map almost exactly onto a 50 kV floor - select 50-131, 132-399, 400. Bands not exact kV, so no per-line rating.

NO substation object type in GeoDanmark: Teknik has Mast but nothing for transformerstation, and TekniskAnlaegPunkt is a BBR marker with no type attribute (checked). So Danish substations have no ODbL-mixable authoritative source - keep OSM for those.

last_updated: Metadata: published 2013-11-28, last revision 2024-08-20 (INSPIRE service record separately dated 2019-04-24)
notes: Technically excellent, legally blocked. Verified this session: geodata-info.dk record 9e479f3e (service) and a4234f1b (dataset, incl. the ISO constraints in Danish), plus the live WFS GetCapabilities (feature types and output formats confirmed; Fees and AccessConstraints elements are empty in the capabilities, which is misleading - the real terms are in the ISO metadata). Access constraint says "no limitations to public access", but the USE constraints bar exactly what we would do with it: digital sharing with third parties is limited to raster with your own information overlaid, internet publication requires a separate agreement with Energinet, and the data may not be used "i forbindelse med projektering" - i.e. design/routeing use. Marked unusable for ODbL fusion and for study work rather than complements_osm, to avoid inflating it. It remains the reference to cite if Denmark becomes commercially material - then negotiate a licence with Energinet directly.

publisher: Lantmateriet
dataset_name: Topografi 10 Nedladdning, vektor - Tema Ledningar
contents: Two layers: Ledningslinje (line) and Transformatoromraade (transformer area, polygon - the Swedish substation proxy). Ledningslinje power classes verbatim: "Kraftledning stam" = "ledningslinje foer elkraftdistribution i regel med en spaenning hoegre aen 200 kV"; "Kraftledning region" = "i regel med en spaenning mellan 25 och 200 kV"; "Kraftledning foerdelning" = "i regel med en spaenning mellan 6 och 24 kV". Also Roerledning (pipeline) and Telefonledning in the same theme.
voltage_detail: No kV attribute. Voltage is encoded only in the three class names (>200 kV / 25-200 kV / 6-24 kV). Attributes are objektidentitet (UUID), versiongiltigfran, lagesosakerhetplan, objekttypnr. A 50 kV floor cannot be applied from the data - the 25-200 kV "region" class straddles it, so you would take stam + region and inherit OSM voltages by spatial match.

publisher: Maanmittauslaitos / National Land Survey of Finland
dataset_name: Maastotietokanta (Topographic Database) - Johtoverkosto theme
contents: Nationwide topographic database. Johtoverkosto (utility networks) theme contains the sahkolinja (power line) table plus muuntoasema (substation, kohdeluokka 24221); muuntaja (transformer, 24211) was removed in the May 2025 update. Line geometry is "viiva".
voltage_detail: No kV attribute. Only a two-way class split by kohdeluokka: 24311 "Suurjaennitelinjan symboli" (high-voltage/transmission line) and 24312 "Jakelujaennitelinjan symboli" (distribution-voltage line). No kV thresholds are published for either class. Because Finland's network is effectively 400/220/110 kV transmission and 20 kV distribution with very little 50-110 kV, 24311 is a workable proxy for ">= 110 kV" but it is not a 50 kV filter and it carries no rating.

download_size: not stated; selectable by bounding box, polygon, map sheet, municipality or theme

The OGC API Features endpoint returns HTTP 401 without a key - confirmed by direct fetch - so a free NLS account is a hard prerequisite. Substations (muuntoasema) live in the same dataset and theme, so no separate entry. Classed complements_osm: survey-grade geometry that improves on OSM, but with no kV attribute you must inherit voltage from OSM by spatial join, and there is no owner/operator or commissioning-date attribution. The karttapaikka file-service UI (asiointi.maanmittauslaitos.fi) is robots-disallowed; use the OGC API Processes endpoint instead.

publisher: Geobasis NRW (Bezirksregierung Koeln) - ATKIS Basis-DLM for North Rhine-Westphalia
dataset_name: Digitales Basis-Landschaftsmodell NW (adv:AX_Leitung)
contents: ATKIS Basis-DLM object class AX_Leitung (object type 51005) - overhead line centrelines. Schema elements verified by DescribeFeatureType: bauwerksfunktion (AX_Bauwerksfunktion_Leitung), spannungsebene (gml:MeasureType, minOccurs=0), name, hat3D, qualitaetsangaben, ergebnisDerUeberpruefung. 3,518 AX_Leitung features in NRW (numberMatched, verified). Substations are carried separately as AX_IndustrieUndGewerbeflaeche with funktion 2540 "Umspannstation" ("Anlage zur Umformung des elektrischen Stroms auf andere Spannungsebenen", Nutzungsartkennung 12030400).
voltage_detail: CAUTION - the schema has a voltage field but the data does not. spannungsebene exists in AX_Leitung (gml:MeasureType, optional) but a live GetFeature of 3 features returned bauwerksfunktion=1110 for all three and NO spannungsebene element at all. bauwerksfunktion 1110 decodes to "Freileitung" and is the ONLY permitted value of AX_Bauwerksfunktion_Leitung in the Saxon ATKIS catalogue - so the class does not distinguish 380 kV from an 11 kV wood-pole overhead line. A 50 kV floor cannot be derived from this data.
format: Shapefile and NAS (zip); WFS 2.0.0 / 1.1.0 with GML 3.1/3.2 output; Atom feed
download_size: basis-dlm_EPSG25832_Shape.zip = 4,691,808,737 bytes (4.69 GB); basis-dlm_EPSG25832_NAS.zip = 1,182,730,388 bytes (1.18 GB); both timestamped 2026-08-19. WFS is the sane route for AX_Leitung alone.

last_updated: Dataset last update 15.07.2026, monthly update cycle; download files timestamped 2026-08-19; WFS response timestamp 2026-08-19T21:27:54+02:00
notes: Most thoroughly verified entry in this survey, and the result is a downgrade. Verified this session: opengeodata.nrw.de directory listing (both zip names and exact byte sizes), the Open.NRW DCAT record 4c8955f8-7c72-498e-bb3a-55b1680a4ec6 (DL-DE/Zero-2.0 with licence URL https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0, "Ueberlandleitung" in keywords, monthly updates), WFS GetCapabilities (adv:AX_Leitung and adv:AX_IndustrieUndGewerbeflaeche feature types, Fees text quoted above, AccessConstraints NONE), DescribeFeatureType for adv:AX_Leitung, a live GetFeature (geometry returned as LineString with Z in EPSG:25832; spannungsebene absent), and RESULTTYPE=hits (3,518). The licence is the best in the region - DL-DE/Zero is CC0-equivalent, no attribution even required. The killer is the missing voltage: geometry is cadastral-grade and clearly better than OSM, but you cannot filter to 50 kV+ and you cannot rate a line, so this is a geometry-refinement source only, joined to OSM voltages. Scope is NRW only - Basis-DLM is held per Bundesland, so national coverage means 16 separate acquisitions (see the Sachsen and basemap.de entries). Before investing, sample spannungsebene across several Laender - it may be populated in some even though NRW leaves it empty.

I verified the file offer itself (names, sizes, dates, GeoPackage/EPSG:4326) and the open-data page's licence statement that terms are per-state "Datenlizenz Deutschland" in Zero or Namensnennung variants, both of which are ODbL-compatible. What I could NOT verify: whether basisviews includes AX_Leitung. Cheapest test: pull basisviews_bdlm_BE_EPSG4326 (83 MB) and run ogrinfo -so. If AX_Leitung is absent, fall back to per-Land Basis-DLM (NRW entry) for the states you need. Per-state currency table is at https://basemap.de/dienste/opendata/basisviews_bdlm_datenaktualitaet.html but it renders client-side and could not be read.

voltage_detail: Not documented. Coverage is described as TenneT's territory in Bavaria rather than its full German control area, so this is not even a complete TenneT DE picture.
format: WMS (GetMap / GetFeatureInfo)
licence_name: TenneT TSO GmbH proprietary - all rights to the network data reserved to TenneT; use bound to the provider's Impressum and terms of use
notes: Verified via the GDI-DE metadata record 58e8e8b8-52d1-4f6f-ad24-521cd29551d3 this session. WMS only, no WFS and no downloadable vector, and the record states all rights in the network data remain with TenneT - so it is a visual cross-check at best. Useful for eyeballing whether an OSM line exists in reality, useless for fusion. Note the alternative endpoint the record also lists: https://geowms.tennet.eu/server/services/open/Leitungsnetz/MapServer/WMSServer - that path shape suggests an ArcGIS Server behind it, so a REST directory MAY be exposed at .../server/rest/services/open/Leitungsnetz/MapServer; I did not verify that and it would not fix the licence. No equivalent published service was found for 50Hertz, Amprion or TransnetBW. The VDE/FNN "Deutsches Hoechstspannungsnetz" map is a printed/PDF cartographic product, not geodata. Licence marked verbatim-null because the record text I saw was machine-translated to English, not the original German.

last_updated: Last data revision 2023-07-15; metadata stamp 2026-07-01; annual update cycle
notes: Verified via the GDI-DE record 19359BA9-1D32-4873-BCC0-7683E590BB86 this session. Two reasons it does not qualify as a geometry source: WMS only (no WFS, no file download), and it is a Baden-Wuerttemberg-hosted redistribution of BNetzA project data rather than a national dataset. Licence is a bespoke UIS usage agreement (terms at https://www.lubw.baden-wuerttemberg.de/umweltinformationssystem/nutzungsvereinbarung) - unresolved, so unclear. Relevance to this project is the compelling-event angle rather than the grid model: it is planned-corridor geometry for BBPlG/EnLAG schemes. Separately I checked BNetzA's own https://www.netzausbau.de/Vorhaben/uebersicht/karte/karte.html - view-only, no shapefile/GeoJSON/WFS/KML offer and no geodata licence statement, so BNetzA publishes no downloadable project geometry.

publisher: RTE (Réseau de Transport d'Électricité) via Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ); mirrored on data.gouv.fr by DDTM de l'Eure (DDTM 27)

CRITICAL: the published line schema carries no voltage field - the fetched ODRÉ field list is Code ligne, Nom ligne and ouvrage/LIT identifiers only. Voltage must be joined from RTE ouvrage references or parsed from line names.

notes: This is the workhorse France line source. Verified twice: the data.gouv.fr dataset page and the /api/1/datasets/lignes-aeriennes-rte/ JSON both list the shapefile resource with the URL above under Licence Ouverte 2.0, and the description states national metropolitan coverage (not just Eure). Two material caveats before fusing: (1) the mirror is a 2023-06-30 snapshot, three years behind the current ODRÉ edition of 2026-06-16, so new-build corridors will be missing; (2) no voltage attribute, so it cannot by itself honour a 50 kV floor. Second shapefile resource on the same page: https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/r/63eacc3a-784e-49eb-a368-65913f7bed1b

publisher: RTE via Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ)
dataset_name: Sites électriques RTE et points de piquage (ODRÉ dataset id postes-electriques-rte)

licence_name: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence v2.0 (as stated for ODRÉ datasets mirrored on data.gouv.fr; not shown on the ODRÉ dataset page itself)
last_updated: 2026-06-16 (edition date shown on the ODRÉ information page)
notes: Honest status: I fetched https://odre.opendatasoft.com/explore/dataset/postes-electriques-rte/information/ and saw title, producer RTE, 2026-06-16 edition and the description - but NOT a download link, so this is fetch_verified=false per the rules. Everything under odre.opendatasoft.com/api/ is robots-disallowed (both /api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/{id} and /exports returned ROBOTS_DISALLOWED), and the /explore/.../export page renders its format list client-side. ODRÉ's geo datasets are NOT mirrored on data.gouv.fr - I pulled the full ODRÉ organisation dataset list (https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/organizations/open-data-reseaux-energies-1/datasets.csv) and only statistical tables are there. However the export URL pattern IS confirmed from a fetched page: the data.gouv.fr record for 'Nombre de postes électriques RTE par région et par niveau de tension' exposes https://odre.opendatasoft.com/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/postes-electriques-region-tension/exports/csv?use_labels=true - the same /exports/{format} route with dataset id postes-electriques-rte should yield geojson, but I did not construct or verify it. Fetch it with a normal HTTP client (not a robots-respecting fetcher) to confirm.

voltage_detail: Not stated in the metadata; inherits RTE site scope (45-400 kV).
format: ESRI Shapefile (also WMS/WFS)
licence_name: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence version 2.0
licence_verbatim: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence Version 2.0

Département-scoped, so useless as a national layer - but it demonstrates that DDT/DREAL bodies republish the ODRÉ RTE layers on Géo-IDE under LO 2.0, and a sweep of those publishers may assemble national substation coverage if the ODRÉ export route stays blocked. A regional alternative with a download link: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes 'Postes du Réseau de Transport d'Electricité de RTE en Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes', https://telechargement.open-datara.fr/download/6ff46060-caa3-11de-ace6-0030485c9eb6 (licence not stated, 2019). A national-coverage WFS mirror also exists at Communauté d'Agglomération du Puy-en-Velay (layer electricite-transport:postes_electriques, https://geoportail.lepuyenvelay.fr/geoserver/wfs?, data as of 2024-06-10) but its data.gouv.fr record states no licence.

publisher: IGN (Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière)
dataset_name: BD TOPO (energy theme: ligne_electrique, poste_de_transformation)
contents: National topographic vector database. Contains an electricity line class (ligne_electrique) and a transformer/substation class (poste_de_transformation) among 35+ classes. Both lines and substations in one product.
voltage_detail: unknown - I could not verify the attribute schema this session. bdtopoexplorer.ign.fr returned 403 and documentation.geoservices.ign.fr failed TLS hostname verification, so I cannot confirm whether ligne_electrique carries numeric kV or a coarse HT/THT class. Treat the voltage attribute as unverified.
format: GeoPackage, ESRI Shapefile, SQL (per-département, per-région and France entière archives)
licence_name: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence version 2.0 (Etalab)
licence_verbatim: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence version 2.0
notes: The URL given is the data.gouv.fr DATASET PAGE, not a file - be aware. I fetched it and confirmed IGN as publisher, LO 2.0, a 2026-07-31 update and 149 resources including shapefile entries with https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/r/{id} URLs, plus a resource titled 'Télécharger BD TOPO® régions, France entière format SQL et GeoPacKage' pointing at https://geoservices.ign.fr/bdtopo#telechargementshpreg. That geoservices URL 302s to https://cartes.gouv.fr/rechercher-une-donnee/dataset/IGNF_BD-TOPO which is a JS app and returned an empty body, so I could NOT copy a national archive file URL. Value proposition: BD TOPO is surveyed 1:5000-class geometry and, unlike the RTE layer, it includes substation polygons - but it is topographic mapping of visible infrastructure, so completeness at 50-90 kV and voltage tagging both need checking against a sample before it is trusted as a voltage-filterable source.

publisher: Nationaal Geografisch Instituut / Institut Géographique National (NGI/IGN Belgium)
dataset_name: Top10Vector – High-voltage network
contents: Two feature types: HT_hightensionlinesegment (high-voltage line segments, x/y/z geometry) and HT_powerpylon (pylons). National coverage of Belgium. No substations - I verified separately that the Top10Vector 'Constructions' theme (CO_Building, CO_Brunnel, CO_Particular*, CO_TowerOnBuilding, ZO_ParticularZone) contains no electricity substation or transformer feature type.
voltage_detail: unknown - the metadata record names the feature types but does not state a voltage threshold or a voltage attribute. As topographic capture of overhead HV lines it will not distinguish 70 kV from 380 kV and will omit underground cable. Attribute schema is in Top10Vector_ProductSpecification_EN.pdf (https://ac.ngi.be/remoteclient-open/ngi-standard-open/Specifications/Vectordata/Top10Vector_ProductSpecification_EN.pdf).
format: GeoPackage 1.3.0 and ESRI Shapefile, in EPSG:3812 (Lambert 2008) and EPSG:4326
licence_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)
licence_verbatim: "Creative Commons Attribution 4.0" (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); "No limitations on public access". NGI's open-data FAQ adds: "you as the user must credit NGI as the creator of the data and provide a link to the licence", modifications must be indicated, and no additional restrictions may be imposed.
last_updated: 2026-01-23 (revision date on the geo.be metadata record)
notes: The single best Belgium source and cleanly licensed. Verified on the federal catalogue record at https://publish.geo.be/geonetwork/srv/api/records/c6c6d674-e3c5-47a9-8398-f4e1082d3e8e, which lists the four direct archive URLs (GPKG and SHP, in 3812 and 4326), the CC BY 4.0 constraint and the 2026-01-23 revision. EPSG:3812 variant: .../c6c6d674-e3c5-47a9-8398-f4e1082d3e8e_geopackage+sqlite3_3812.zip; shapefiles substitute _x-shapefile_. ATOM download service: https://ac.ngi.be/remoteclient-open/ngi-standard-open/ATOM/52fa45ee-89df-11ee-b89a-089204088251-en.xml. WMS: https://data.geo.be/ws/top10vector/wms?service=wms&request=getcapabilities&version=1.3.0. Not marked supersedes_osm because there is no voltage attribute (so it cannot be filtered to the 50 kV floor), no substations, and probably no underground cable - it is a geometry-accuracy reference and a completeness check, not a replacement. Note the file bundles pylons with lines; drop HT_powerpylon on import.

publisher: Elia Transmission Belgium
dataset_name: Elia Open Data Portal (opendata.elia.be) - negative finding
contents: 106 datasets, but market and system operation timeseries (load, physical flows, generation, balancing, congestion), not network geometry. No downloadable line or substation GIS layer found. The transmission hosting-capacity map at https://opendata.elia.be/map/ is an interactive viewer.

licence_name: Elia Open Data Licence

publisher: TenneT TSO B.V.
dataset_name: TenneT Assets Hoogspanning (ArcGIS FeatureServer)
contents: Six layers verified from the service directory: Mast (0), Bliksemdraad (1), Hoogspanning leiding bovengronds (2, overhead lines), Hoogspanning kabel ondergronds (3, underground cables), Opstijgpunt (4), Hoogspanning station (5, substations). Lines AND substations in one service. Service description: 'Hoogspanningsnet Nederland - Asset gegevens TenneT TSO B.V.'
voltage_detail: Service description states 'public information about Dutch high-voltage stations and connections of 110 kV and above currently in operation'. The OSM wiki documents the source voltage field as SE_FLD**_SPANNINGSNIVEAU, mapped to OSM voltage in volts (e.g. 110000, or 110000;10000 at mixed substations). So a usable numeric voltage attribute exists - the only entry in this region where that is confirmed.
format: ArcGIS FeatureServer (JSON query; supports ConvertFormat, Get Estimates, Create Replica - so extract is possible). Max 2000 records per query.
licence_name: "Alle rechten voorbehouden. TenneT TSO B.V." (all rights reserved) per the ArcGIS item licenseInfo - contradicted by a public-domain statement recorded by the OSM community
licence_verbatim: licenseInfo: "Alle rechten voorbehouden. TenneT TSO B.V."; accessInformation: "TenneT TSO B.V." (fetched from https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/02d4cfaf2a9241b68f9520748081d7e9?f=json). Counter-evidence on the OSM wiki: "TenneT states that this dataset is in the public domain and fit for use within OpenStreetMap", sourced to an email from TenneT, plus "ArcGIS states that they are only providing the online environment and do not pose any additional license restrictions."
notes: Two things matter here. (1) The licence is the gate and it is genuinely ambiguous: the machine-readable licenseInfo says all rights reserved, while https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Power_networks/Netherlands/TenneT_Hoogspanning_Dataset records an emailed public-domain declaration. Get that in writing before fusing, or the ODbL output is contaminated. (2) Circularity risk: OSM's Dutch 110 kV+ network has already been built from this dataset under that permission, so fusing it may add little beyond currency and will not be an independent cross-check. Use it to date-check rather than to fill gaps. Not supersedes_osm precisely because the licence is not established as reusable.

publisher: Liander / Alliander N.V. (regional DSO - Gelderland, Noord-Holland, Friesland, Flevoland, Zuid-Holland part)
dataset_name: Liander Open Data Elektra (ArcGIS FeatureServer) / 'Liggingsgegevens elektriciteitsnetten'
contents: Nine layers with verified individual endpoints, including Hoogspanningskabel (FeatureServer/632, underground), Hoogspanningskabel bovengronds (638, overhead), Hoogspanningsstation (641), Stationsterrein (530), Stationsgebouw (644), plus MS/LS cables and stations. Lines AND substations. Layers follow the Netbeheer Nederland Open Data Guidelines; sourced from Alliander's asset register and refreshed monthly by script.
voltage_detail: The uniform Netbeheer Nederland classification used by this dataset (confirmed on the data.overheid.nl record) is HS >= 50 kV, MS >400 V and <50 kV, LS <=400 V. So the Hoogspanning layers are exactly the 50 kV sub-transmission tier that the OSM dataset's floor is set to capture. Item snippet notes the HS content is 'deels van Liander, deels van TenneT' - partly TenneT-owned assets shown for context, so deduplicate against the TenneT service.
format: ArcGIS FeatureServer (JSON query / ConvertFormat)
licence_name: CC BY 4.0
licence_verbatim: ArcGIS item licenseInfo: "Open data: CC-BY (4.0)"; accessInformation: "Alliander". data.overheid.nl records the licence as "CC-BY (4.0)". Disclaimer on the companion web map: "Aan deze data en/of informatie kunt u geen rechten ontlenen. Gebruik ervan is geheel voor eigen rekening en risico."
last_updated: 2025-01-07 (FeatureServer item modified); web map 2024-04-30; monthly automated refresh claimed
notes: The strongest sub-transmission find in the region: a DSO publishing 50 kV lines and substations under plain CC BY 4.0. Verified via https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/11b7bcf1b78b4462b91db0dff234cf78?f=json (licence + service URL) and the web-map item data at .../items/0097c633fb7f421aad7053f55060fa9c/data?f=json which enumerated the layer endpoints. Layer ids to pull: 632 and 638 (HS cable), 641 (HS station), 530/644 (station terrain/building). Beware: the no-rights-derived disclaimer is a liability disclaimer, not a licence restriction - the licence field is unambiguous. Note PDOK retired Liander's 'Ligging Elektriciteitsnetwerken' service, so use this ArcGIS endpoint rather than the old geodata.nationaalgeoregister.nl WFS.

publisher: Stedin Netbeheer B.V. (regional DSO - Zuid-Holland, Utrecht, Zeeland)
dataset_name: Open liggingsdata kabels en leidingen
contents: Per-asset shapefile archives. High-voltage set: hoogspanningsverbindingen.zip (HS connections/lines) and hoogspanningsstations.zip (HS substations). Also MS/LS stations and connections, and a Zeeland basisgegevens bundle.
voltage_detail: Page states the classification explicitly: HS (hoogspanning) >= 50 kV; MS >400 V and <50 kV; LS <=400 V. Coordinates in Amersfoort / RD New (EPSG:28992).
format: ESRI Shapefile in ZIP; also an ArcGIS-based interactive map
licence_name: No licence stated; disclaimer only
licence_verbatim: "Aan deze gegevens kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend" and "Getoonde gegevens vervangen in GEEN geval de verplichting voor een KLIC-melding". No open licence is named anywhere on the page.
notes: Direct static ZIPs, verified by re-fetching the page for literal hrefs. Companion substation file: https://www.stedin.net/-/media/project/online/files/zakelijk/branches/liggingsdata/hoogspanningsstations.zip?rev=e6f391619c7d43cd82dcdb21e5e99157 . Licence is the problem - Stedin publishes this as 'open data' but names no licence, so it is 'unclear' and must not be mixed into an ODbL product without written confirmation. Since Liander (CC BY 4.0) and Enexis publish equivalent HS layers under the same Netbeheer Nederland schema, the three DSO sets plus TenneT would give complete Dutch 50 kV+ coverage if the licences can be resolved.

publisher: Enexis Netbeheer (regional DSO - Noord-Brabant, Limburg, Overijssel, Drenthe, Groningen)
dataset_name: Dataset liggingsgegevens elektriciteitsnetten / Assetdata
contents: Described as 'liggingsgegevens van alle elektriciteitstransportkabels én de belangrijkste stations' - all electricity transport cables plus the principal stations. Separate Assetdata product gives geographical information on the physical components of the electricity and gas networks.
voltage_detail: Not stated on the open-data page; Enexis uses the same Netbeheer Nederland HS/MS/LS classification (HS >= 50 kV) as Liander and Stedin, and a datapaspoort PDF exists at https://www.enexis.nl/-/media/enexis-nl/pdf-documents/open-data/datapaspoort_liggingsgegevens_elektriciteitsnet_enexis.pdf. Treat 50 kV as the expected floor, unverified.
format: unknown - not stated; requests are handled through a form
licence_name: unknown - not stated on the open-data page
notes: I fetched https://www.enexis.nl/over-ons/waar-staan-wij-voor/open-data and confirmed the network-location dataset is listed, but access runs through a Spotler request form - no direct file URL, no format, no licence on the page. Worth a request email because Enexis owns 110 kV sub-transmission in the south and east, which is inside the OSM dataset's voltage band. Note the sector-level claim 'Elektriciteitsnet regionale netbeheerders als uniforme open data beschikbaar' (https://www.enexisgroep.nl/nieuws/elektriciteitsnet-regionale-netbeheerders-als-uniforme-open-data-beschikbaar/) - the three DSOs agreed a common schema, so one licence conversation may unlock all three.

Cannot supersede OSM because it carries no voltage: it is a topographic layer of overhead electric lines at all voltages, so it will contain large volumes of sub-50 kV distribution mixed with the HV network and offers no way to separate them. Use it as a positional cross-check for Veneto (does OSM geometry sit on the CTR trace?) and as a completeness hint, not as a voltage-classified source. Whether any >=50 kV content exists is unverified.

notes: Thorough negative finding for the Portuguese regulator/ministry. contents: National 1:10,000 topographic base. format: FGDB (whole-country ZIP); also WFS and ATOM services

Object catalogue pages for ft_at030 and ft_ad030 fetched separately and confirm line geometry + kV attribute + a distinct substation feature type. 1.5 m positional precision beats OSM materially. Two caveats for fusion: (1) the dated filename rotates — re-read the dataset feed rather than hardcoding; (2) NAPETI is a VARCHAR, so expect dirty values and multi-circuit strings. ZABAGED also carries pylons/towers, which are out of scope here.

licence_name: LGIA open data are CC BY 4.0, but the Topo50 vector product is not confirmed to be within that open set
licence_verbatim: LGIA open data page states the licence as "Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Public License", data "freely used, modified and redistributed". BUT that page's dataset inventory lists only orthophoto, digital height model, raster maps (1:250k, 1:50k, satellite), INSPIRE themes (land cover, contours, hydrography, orthophoto, geonames, grid), place names and the geodetic network database — the topographic VECTOR product is absent from it. Hence 'unclear'.
notes: Honest split verdict, both halves fetched this session. Confirmed: the product exists in vector form and does contain HV transmission lines (LGIA node/863). Not confirmed: that it is free or openly licensed. The only concrete URLs on that page point at the LGIA open-data S3 bucket for the specification and the sheet-division files — 's3.storage.pub.lvdc.gov.lv/lgia-opendata/citi/1_50000_v2/Karsu lapu dalijums TOPO50_DGN.zip' — i.e. metadata about the product, not the data. I tried to list the bucket root and got HTTP 403; latvija.gov.lv service 8514 (the ordering catalogue entry) rendered no substantive content. Mirror search per instruction was negative: data.gov.lv CKAN returned count 0 for 'elektro' and 0 LGIA topographic datasets. Best next step is a direct request to LGIA quoting node/863, asking whether the Topo50 vector falls under their CC BY 4.0 open data licence. AST (Augstsprieguma tīkls, the TSO) publishes no downloadable geometry I could find.

publisher: VšĮ Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra / VĮ GIS-Centras (geoportal.lt), Ministry of Agriculture
dataset_name: GDR50LT georeferenced spatial dataset — layer ELEKTR_L
contents: National 1:50,000 georeferenced dataset with a dedicated electricity transmission layer. Verbatim from the official specification: layer 'ELEKTR_L' (Section 8), object classes 'Antžeminės aukštos įtampos elektros energijos perdavimo linijos' (overhead HV transmission lines, code ie6) and 'Požeminės aukštos įtampos elektros energijos perdavimo linijos' (underground HV transmission lines, code ie7), with attribute 'ITAMPA' — 'Įtampos reikšmė kV' (voltage value in kV) as a numeric field.
voltage_detail: The specification states the layer covers transmission lines of 35 kV and higher, and carries a numeric ITAMPA field holding the kV value. That is a better-shaped voltage attribute than most sources in this region — a ≥50 kV filter would be a clean numeric query. This is exactly the dataset you want and exactly the one that is not published openly.
format: Per specification: ESRI Shapefile / geodatabase (not distributed as open data)
licence_name: Not stated for GDR50LT (the geoportal.lt open datasets that ARE published carry CC BY 4.0)
licence_verbatim: No licence statement found for GDR50LT. For contrast, the published open datasets on geoportal.lt are explicitly "CC BY 4.0" — e.g. GRPK at https://www.geoportal.lt/download/opendata/GRPK/GRPK_Open_SHP.zip, updated monthly by the 10th.
notes: The specification PDF was fetched and read this session (https://www.geoportal.lt/download/Specifikacijos/GDR50LT_specifikacija.pdf) — layer code, object classes ie6/ie7, the ITAMPA kV field and the 35 kV scope are all verbatim from it. I then fetched the full geoportal.lt open-data inventory (both the English and Lithuanian pages, 22+ datasets enumerated with direct URLs) and GDR50LT/GDR10LT are absent: 'These datasets are not listed or downloadable on this page', and no 'elektros linijos' dataset appears. Separately confirmed the negative on the open product: GRPK_Open_SHP.zip is CC BY 4.0 and monthly, but GRPK's documented content is roads, streets, railways, streams, water and building and forest and agricultural boundaries, geodetic and height points — no utility networks. So Lithuania has the best-specified electricity layer in the region behind a closed door. Worth one direct request to GIS-Centras.

publisher: AB Energijos skirstymo operatorius (ESO) — the national DSO
dataset_name: ESO elektros tinklo duomenų rinkinys (ESO electricity network dataset)
contents: The DSO's own network. Verbatim scope from the geoportal.lt publication announcement: 'visų įtampų oro ir kabelių linijas bei transformatorines' — overhead and cable lines of ALL voltages, plus transformer substations. Refreshed daily ('atnaujinami kiekvieną dieną').
voltage_detail: 'Visų įtampų' — all voltages, i.e. ESO's full 0.4 kV to 110 kV estate. This is precisely the 50–110 kV sub-transmission coverage the OSM floor makes valuable, and it includes substations.
format: Was served as view services through geoportal.lt; now via the ESO contractors' map at maps.eso.lt
licence_name: Not stated
licence_verbatim: Withdrawal notice on the geoportal.lt ESO theme page: "nuo 2025 m. birželio 1 d. ESO tinklo geografiniai duomenys, tinklo elementų techniniai duomenys, elektros transformatorinių, linijų ir elektros spintų schemos, kabelių linijų pasai, oro linijų atramų inventoriniai apyrašai bus prieinami tik per ESO rangovų žemėlapį" and "nuo 2025 m. geoportal.lt prieigos terminai nepratęsiami ir nauji naudotojai neregistruojami" — from 1 June 2025 available only via the ESO contractors' map; geoportal.lt access terms are not being renewed and new users are not being registered.
last_updated: Daily refresh while published; access route changed 2025-06-01
notes: CORRECTS A STALE LEAD — flagging this explicitly because the optimistic version is what a search will surface first. geoportal.lt published an announcement that ESO electricity and gas data were 'now publicly available' (fetched: layers, all voltages, substations, daily updates, at https://www.geoportal.lt/geoportal/ab-energijos-skirstymo-operatorius). I then fetched the current ESO theme page and found the withdrawal notice quoted above: since 1 June 2025 access moved to the contractor-gated ESO rangovų žemėlapis at maps.eso.lt, geoportal.lt terms are not renewed, and no new users are registered. So the dataset is real, ideal in scope, and now closed to us. A residual record exists at https://data.gov.lt/datasets/3455/ ('ESO elektros tinklo duomenų rinkinys', organisation https://data.gov.lt/orgs/15/) but data.gov.lt returns HTTP 403 to every fetch I attempted, so I could not read its resources or licence — treat data.gov.lt as portal-blocked and worth a manual browser check.

publisher: Zeměměřický úřad / ČÚZK
dataset_name: DATA50 — layer ElektrickeVedeni
contents: Digital geographic model of Czechia at 1:50,000, 69 object types across eight themes (one theme being pipelines and electrical lines). Line layer 'ElektrickeVedeni' with attributes DATA50_K (classification code) and DATA50_P (code description). Only one electricity class is captured: 'elektrické vedení velmi vysokého napětí', code 1290000. No substation layer.
voltage_detail: A single categorical class, 'elektrické vedení velmi vysokého napětí' (very-high-voltage line), code 1290000 — no kV values at all. I am deliberately not converting the Czech VVN band to a kV floor here: the catalogue does not state one and the conventional band boundary is contested. Use ZABAGED's numeric NAPETI instead.
format: ESRI Shapefile
licence_name: Creative Commons CC BY 4.0
licence_verbatim: ČÚZK DATA50 page: price "Free"; licence "Creative Commons CC BY 4.0" — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.cs. ATOM service at https://atom.cuzk.gov.cz/Data50/Data50.xml.
notes: Verified and open, but effectively redundant: same publisher and same CC BY 4.0 licence as ZABAGED, while being coarser (1:50,000 vs 1:10,000), carrying no kV values (one categorical class vs ZABAGED's numeric NAPETI) and having no substation layer. Listed for completeness and because the download is small and trivially usable for a quick sanity overlay. If you ingest one Czech source, ingest ZABAGED. Both the layer catalogue (Data50_katalog_SHP.pdf) and the dataset page with the direct ZIP URLs above were fetched this session.
